description: Inline-image case 4: phone photo of a document (council tax bill) sent inline with a cid reference, JPEG 3024x4032, 143076 bytes -> possible KYC (C-RED-0 3: fails B.6 thresholds on long side, short side and bytes). Investor sends proof of address -> kyc_documents (high) -> safe_ack.
notes: Attachment 0 (IMG_4821.jpeg) satisfies a-e (outer part, unique Content-Id referenced by the HTML, inline, base64, structurally valid JPEG with a small Exif APP1 and no thumbnail) but fails f: 4032 > 400, 3024 > 150, bytes > 51,200. Filename has no C-RED-0 1 word, so only 3 catches it. The scan is a uniform grey baseline image built by hand (decodable); real phone photos are larger. T-NW-0008 by reference (W4-3: listed for every linked commitment).
